=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:augment_files_touched (entire function) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The function uses a generic `try...except Exception:` block that swallows all errors and still returns a default success summary (`"ok": True`) when augmentation fails.
  WHY: Any unexpected failure in decomposition JSON handling or the gate module call is hidden from the poller, so it cannot see that test-coverage augmentation failed. The source severity was MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject this point as the documented fail-open contract and say it is outside the last-run scope.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:_prepush_select_planned_paths | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The function runs one subprocess per issue in a loop inside the orchestrator polling tick.
  WHY: With many issues, the poll step's total time budget may be exceeded, the tick may time out, and every later pipeline action is delayed. The source severity was MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes that each subprocess has its own 5-300 s timeout, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash calls the point speculative and out of last-run scope.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:700-708 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main` writes `INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE=true` to `GITHUB_ENV` (line 702) before it evaluates `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` (line 704), so mode=off still suppresses the whole review pipeline.
  WHY: With `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE=off` and `post_sync_test_repair=true` on a manual dispatch, the reviewer, editor, gate, commit and auto-merge steps all skip. The run goes green and the only log line is `reason=mode_off`. The source severity was NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject this as intentional, documented behaviour that the poller-side mode gate prevents.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:622-633 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `review_prepush_test_gate_main` sets `rpg_venv`/`rpg_node_modules` from `${REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT}` but has no `venv_absent` warning when the root has no dependency venv, unlike the integration path (line 754) and the resolver path.
  WHY: Without the venv, every pytest suite degrades to `unverified` (`pytest_unavailable`) with no explanatory log line, so an operator cannot tell a missing venv from a suite that genuinely cannot be verified. The source severity was NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raise the same point as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:803-817 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The usage comment above `review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate` (line 803) leaves out the `--node-modules DIR` option, which the function parses (line 817).
  WHY: The comment misleads maintainers about the script's interface. The source severity was NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raise the same point as a hardening suggestion, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 also notes the missing `[--image-reason R]`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: plan P5 step 6 — "Registries, `changelog.d`, and an `agents.d` fragment appending to `Workflow architecture` (new log keys under `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=integration`)", plus the registry rule that new phases and keys under the existing `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE` prefix are recorded in the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry entry
  expected_change_site: one of agents.d/8189-prepush-gate-orchestrator-scoping.md, agents.d/8190-prepush-gate-implement.md, agents.d/8201-prepush-gate-review-resolver-heal.md or agents.d/8210-prepush-gate-integration-repair.md, with a `<!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" -->` block that extends the `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE` registry bullet
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: agents.md:3993 still lists only `phase=run`, `phase=config` and `phase=wrapper` for `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE`. agents.md:4369 `LOG_PREFIX.name=PREPUSH_TEST_GATE` is unchanged. None of the four new fragments (agents.d/8189, 8190, 8201, 8210) has a "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" block. The PR emits the new phases `phase=augment|implement|review|resolver|heal|integration` and new reasons (node_modules_missing, venv_missing, nested_node_modules_*, venv_absent), which appear only in the "Pre-push affected-test gate" prose. Repo precedent at docs/plans/sandbox-aware-unblock-and-implements-marker-plan.md:130 is a registry bullet without a new `LOG_PREFIX.name=` line.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

The PR adds the phases augment, implement, review, resolver, heal and integration, the reasons node_modules_missing, venv_missing and nested_node_modules_*, and `reason=venv_absent`.

- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, review_prepush_test_gate_main, after `rpg_venv="${root}/source/.review-venv"`. Review mode logs nothing when the venv is absent. Fix: add `elif [ -n "${root}" ]; then review_prepush_test_gate_log "outcome=warning reason=venv_absent"` (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, the comment above review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate. It leaves out `[--node-modules DIR] [--image-reason R]`. Fix: add them to the comment (1 line).

- NOTES (checked, no defect): the --node-modules forwarding is valid because node_modules survives the refresh (scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:31 EXCLUDED); `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS` forwarding matches scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:160; the venv_absent warnings are logging only; the test fixtures are correct.
